scientific_rules: Never vertically extrude a 2-D radar image and describe it as a measured radar volume.
Live STxxxx identities are algorithmic tracks derived from public 2-D radar footprints unless a true volume source is explicitly present.
Doppler values are radial-velocity display classes, not horizontal storm motion.
Satellite observations may support cloud-top trend/context but are not radar echo-top measurements.
Official Bureau warnings are cross-check information and are not ground truth for every detected storm.
Inferred lightning likelihood is ordinal research/exercise guidance, not a detected strike and not a calibrated probability.
